Name: Bog's Witchy Tools
Author: BogWyytch
Description:
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/HL7HB5pG/retro-bookcase-(6).png[/img]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/90m2Bn8T/harp-animated.gif[/img][/center][size=5][b][center]﻿2.0 BOG'S WITCHY TOOLS UPDATE IS HERE![/center][/b][/size]
[size=3]
Welcome everyone to the [b]2.0 Update of Bog's Witchy Tools[/b]! This is one of the first in a series of updates now that Abagaianye is a part of the Bogwood Valley team! We are so happy to be able to go back into the entire Bog catalogue and make updates, compatibilities, and fixes that have been long requested. 
[/size]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/7L10G5pw/retro-bookcase-(4).png[/img]﻿
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/KjWMSBgD/retro-bookcase-(5).png[/img]
[u][b][center][size=5]FEATURES﻿

[/size][/center][/b][/u]The 2.0 Update for Bog's Witchy Tools includes some new features and updates to existing ones:
[list]
[*]5 color options for the Iridium Tools
[*]The Horse Flute is now the "Mount Harp" which has its own harp sound and animation!
[*]The Pans now have their own animation as well.
[*]FINALLY Iridium Fishing Rods will now match their color in the actual fishing animation with the mod [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25258]Colorful Fishing Rods[/url]
[/list][img]https://i.postimg.cc/MH7cnNcy/5.png[/img]
[center][u][b][size=5]CONFIGS[/size][/b][/u][/center]
[b][u]Iridium Color[/u][/b][list]
[*]Choose between green, purple, pink, red, or blue for the iridium tools.
[/list]
[b][u]Enable Tools[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Enable the retextured axe, fishing rods, hoe, milk pail, pan, pickaxe, return sceptre, shears, trash can, and watering can.
[*]We will not take requests to toggle any of the tools on this list individually due to the performance cost.
[/list]
[b][u]Enable Scythe[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Enable the retextured scythe.
[/list]
[b][u]Enable Horse Flute[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Retexture the horse flute into a harp. Disable to use another mod's retexture instead.
[/list]
[b][u]Change Horse Flute Name[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Whether to rename the horse flute to Mount Harp. Default enabled.
[*]When enabled it will change the name even if "Enable Flute" is disabled.
[/list]
[b][u]Change Horse Flute Music[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Whether to change the horse flute sound to a harp sound. Default enabled.
[*]Requires a game restart after disabling for changes to take effect.
[*]When enabled it will change the sound even if "Enable Flute" is disabled.
[/list]
[b][u]Fishing Rod Recolor[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Recolor your fishing rod while fishing to match the fishing rod sprite. Default enabled.
[*]Does nothing if Colorful Fishing Rods is not installed.
[/list]
[b][u]Bog's Prismatic Tools[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]Enable this to Boggify your prismatic tools.
[*]Does nothing if Prismatic Tools Continued is not installed.
[/list]
[b][u]Animate Aimon's Harp[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]If you're playing with the harp from Aimon's Fancy Qi Items and Misc Stuff Retexture, this will make the harp animation match it.
[*]It will not detect whether you have disabled Aimon's harp, so if you do disable it you will need to also disable this.
[*]Disable to return the animation to the default vanilla flute playing.
[*]Does nothing if Fancy Qi Items and Misc Stuff Retexture is not installed.
[/list]
[img]https://i.postimg.cc/hvcCQFyR/4.png[/img]
[center][u][b][size=5]ACCESSIBILITY[/size][/b][/u][/center]
[b][u]Vision
[/u][/b] [u][i]Stardew Access[/i][/u][list]
[*]This mod is technically compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16205]Stardew Access[/url].
[*]Most of the mod consists of purely visual changes.
[*]However, the Horse Flute is changed into a Mount Harp. The name, description, and music played when summoning your mount have been altered. These changes work correctly when playing with Stardew Access.
[/list]
[u] [i]Trypophobia[/i][/u][list]
[*]This mod should be trypophobia safe.
[/list]
[b][u]Sound[/u][/b]
[list]
[*]This mod contains a custom harp sound when using the Horse Flute. It can be disabled in the config using the "Change Flute Music" setting.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/33544]Stardew Audio Captions[/url]﻿: Use SAC to provide text captions for sounds in-game. Currently the caption for playing the Mount Harp is still "Flute playing" but this will be changed to "Harp playing" in a future update.
[/list]
We welcome requests for any additional accessibility changes our players may need. A list of mods providing accessibility and ease of play tools can be found [url=https://stardewmodding.wiki.gg/wiki/Accessibility_and_Ease_of_Play]here[/url] (the list may not always be up to date).

[size=5][u][b][center]COMPATIBILITY[/center][/b][/u][/size]
[list]
[*]Tool rexture mods: This mod has config options to disable some of the tools, so it can be used with other retexture mods.
[*]Aimon's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/16451]Fancy Qi Items and Misc Stuff Retexture[/url]: This mod has special compatibility with Aimon's mod. If you want to use the harp from Aimon's mod instead, this mod adds a playing animation for it.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25258]Colorful Fishing Rods[/url]: When CFR is installed, the iridium-coloured fishing rods will have their animations coloured according to the chosen iridium colour. Thanks to user Yezziii for offering the json for the green colour.
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21450]Prismatic Tools Continued[/url]: There is a config option to Boggify the prismatic tools.
[/list]

[center][u][b][size=5]UNINSTALLATION[/size][/b][/u][/center][list]
[*]You can uninstall this mod at any time.
[*]Simply delete the mod folder.
[/list]
[center][img]https://i.postimg.cc/TwTB8WrH/panning-animated.gif[/img]
